does: Sends an entity's animation blueprint the gameplay event ASCancelAnimation (id e131c8d9-6049-40a6-a565-73038fedc938) with one flag as its argument: the animation the ASAnimation event started ends.

evidence.says: It builds an event description with the id global filled from the string e131c8d9-..., writes the byte its third parameter points at as argument 0 and calls the generic TriggerGameplayEvent; ecl::ASAnimation::Update reaches it through +0x1BC4BA0 when the state is left.
Called for a client-only timeline dummy that loops an animation, the blueprint raises its end events for the entity within the next frames; none came in the three seconds before.
the macOS build's symbols hold this name; it is tied to this function by the job its read shows
